activities.title: Practice Speaking
activities.instruction: Listen carefully! 🎧 Clear your ears and closely! 🎧 Switch on your ears and to the phrases from the story. Then, record yourself saying them.
activities.compensates: Teacher modeling pronunciation and class repetition drills.

activities.title: Describe the Last Picture
activities.instruction: Use your eyes! 🧐 Use your eyes! 🧐 Look closely at the carefully at the at the last picture of the story. Answer the questions to describe what is happening.
activities.compensates: Teacher asking students to interpret the pictures and describe them.

sampleAnswers: I can see Fatma and her little sister, Amna.
The camera is broken. Amna took the film out.
Fatma feels shocked and sad. Amna looks upset.
promptQuestions: Who can you see in the last picture?
How does Fatma feel? How does Amna feel?
